text.p: Ostex International Inc Tuesday announced the resignations of Chairman and Chief Executive Officer H. Raymond Cairncross and Chief Operating Officer Robert Glaser.
"I am stepping aside because I believe it is time for new management to take the great opportunities at Ostex forward," Cairncross, who co-founded the company in 1989, said in a statement.

Ostex said Thomas J. Cable, an Ostex director since 1989, was elected Chairman. Bob Littauer and Jeff Miller, Ostex' Chief Financial Officer and Senior Vice President of Corporate Development, respectively, will serve in the newly-created Office of the President.
The company has initiated a search to fill the CEO position.
